summary: I have over 19 years of experience in software development, primarily as a .NET Developer. I am experienced in creating technical documentation, designing and developing new functionality, building integration solutions, maintaining, refactoring, and extending existing code, as well as software testing across both on-premises and cloud (Azure) environments, spanning backend and frontend technologies. I am skilled in MS SQL query optimisation. I am focused on full-stack development and comfortable taking on leadership roles within projects. I use AI tools, including Claude & Antigravity, to improve my work and productivity. I am a team player, open-minded, and willing to share my knowledge with others.
